mapper.select: SELECT pps.*, s.id as s_id, s.name as s_name, s.skill_type as s_skill_type, s.pet_type as s_pet_type, s.power as s_power, s.accuracy as s_accuracy, s.max_pp as s_max_pp, s.priority as s_priority, s.status_effect as s_status_effect, s.effect_chance as s_effect_chance, s.description as s_description FROM player_pet_skill pps LEFT JOIN skill s ON pps.skill_id = s.id WHERE pps.player_pet_id = #{playerPetId}

SELECT pps.*, s.id as s_id, s.name as s_name, s.skill_type as s_skill_type, s.pet_type as s_pet_type, s.power as s_power, s.accuracy as s_accuracy, s.max_pp as s_max_pp, s.priority as s_priority, s.status_effect as s_status_effect, s.effect_chance as s_effect_chance, s.description as s_description FROM player_pet_skill pps LEFT JOIN skill s ON pps.skill_id = s.id WHERE pps.player_pet_id = #{playerPetId} AND pps.is_equipped = TRUE ORDER BY pps.position
mapper.update: UPDATE player_pet_skill SET player_pet_id = #{playerPetId}, skill_id = #{skillId}, current_pp = #{currentPp}, max_pp = #{maxPp}, position = #{position}, is_equipped = #{isEquipped}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
